entities.name: Nobumasa Fukuda

entities.summary:
Nobumasa Fukuda  is a Japanese former professional baseball infielder and current coach for the Chunichi Dragons of Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB). He played in NPB for Chunichi from
2007 to 2023.
